race.description: Our Lady Of The Southern Cross College Hcp (58)
race.comment: LADY WILLPOWER (6) was in contention on the corner and ran a better race last start to finish a close second over 1110m at Toowoomba after missing the placings at the previous appearance. Well placed and there is no reason why she cannot find winning ways. VESPER LYND (4) tasted defeat last start when eighth over 1015m at Toowoomba, beaten 4.5 lengths. In the right race this time and is capable of sharp improvement. ROCKY BLONDE (8) is usually thereabouts and is a must for the exotics players. DRUMS OF WAR (1) was thereabouts two starts back but didn't impress last start when ninth over 800m at Ipswich. Look for an improved run.
